method: Actual native Chrome WebGPU rendering with the exact served journey-poster-renderer.js, unchanged WGSL, back-face culling and exported GLBs. A local six-model gallery serializes mounts through the bounded decoder, waits for returned first-submission promises, fonts and decoded fallback images, and uses setRotation at 0, pi/4 and pi/2. Static images are hidden during GPU inspection.

gpu.deviceString: ANGLE (Apple, ANGLE Metal Renderer: Apple M4 Max, Version 15.7.4 (Build 24G517))

observations.all_six_front_profile_three_quarter: Closed, visible silhouettes with no missing front or side faces. The original armillary agrees with the existing series in ivory material, fine grain, cavity shading and shadows.
observations.armillary: Faceted globe, four distinct orbital bands, connected polar spindle and turned base remain visible in every angle.
observations.reduced_motion: All six native gallery models remain static after angle input and reach zero queued animation frames.
observations.fallbacks: Every WebP was decoded and inspected with its canvas hidden; gallery rendering stops scheduling frames.
observations.renderer_disposal: All six devices, buffers, textures, contexts and queued frames are released after gallery disposal in both motion modes.
observations.production_csp: The ordinary /subscribe page loads its GLB and the same-origin decoding Worker and submits actual native WGSL frames under the served production policy.
observations.navigation_cleanup: Leaving the newsletter destroys its GPU device. Resuming the retained DOM with Save-Data or unavailable GPU uses the decoded poster, hides orbit controls and resets sound to off.

evidence: /tmp/engmanager-marble-subscribe-review/native: raw report, actual front/profile/three-quarter captures, fallback captures and desktop/mobile newsletter captures. Blender source studies are in the sibling blender directory.
scope: Export appearance and native renderer/newsletter lifecycle proof. Integrated navigation, CSS Continue effects, performance budgets and the complete CI suite are verified separately.
